valkyrie.desc: Level 20 PassiveIncreases your attack power by 25% and your spell hit rating by 5% of your Strength.

valkyrie.name: Valkyr's Grip
valkyrie.desc: Level 10 PassiveAllows you to dual wield and to wield a Two-Handed Mace, Sword, or Polearm in each hand and your chance to hit is increased by 6%.

valkyrie.name: Radiant Power
valkyrie.desc: Each stack of Sunwalker now increases the critical strike chance of Shine by 3%.

valkyrie.name: Knight of Dawn
valkyrie.desc: Your Glorious Execution now has a 20% chance to strike 1 additional time.

valkyrie.name: Solar Empowerment
valkyrie.desc: Fulfilling your Vow now unleashes a chain of light at your target, dealing holy AP Holy damage and then bouncing to up to 5 additional enemies, dealing reduced damage with each strike.

valkyrie.name: Sun's Gift
valkyrie.desc: Level 30 PassiveYour Horusath Blast now deals additional damage scaling with your attack power and grants allies Replenishment.ReplenishmentRestores 1% maximum mana every 5 sec to allies within 100 yds for 15 seconds.

valkyrie.name: Champion of the Sun
valkyrie.desc: Become a champion of An'she, causing your melee auto attacks to deal an additional 50% of the damage dealt as Holy damage. Lasts 20 seconds.

valkyrie.name: Herald of Purity
valkyrie.desc: Damage dealt by Justice now has an 8% chance to reset its own cooldown.

valkyrie.name: Blessed Magic
valkyrie.desc: Casting Horusath Blast now resets the cooldown of Glorious Execution.

valkyrie.name: Glorious Execution
valkyrie.desc: Strike with both weapons dealing Weapon Damage plus 8 Physical damage and regenerate mana equal to 5% of the damage dealt.

valkyrie.name: Fanaticism
valkyrie.desc: Increases the effectiveness of Gavels and Horusath Blast and reduces their mana cost by -20%.

valkyrie.name: Valkyr's Calling
valkyrie.desc: Target an enemy and leap into the air, becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 2 seconds. At the end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing SP Holy damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

valkyrie.name: Radiant Marks
valkyrie.desc: Reduces the channel time of Sunslam by 1 sec.

valkyrie.name: Fervor of the Sun
valkyrie.desc: Fulfilling a Vow now increases the damage of your Sunslam by 10% for 1 minute, stacking 5 times.

valkyrie.name: Pendant of the Sun
valkyrie.desc: Activate your pendant of the sun, refreshing the duration and all charges of Dawn.

valkyrie.name: Sunsworn
valkyrie.desc: Increases your Physical damage dealt by 6% and auto attacks now have a 10% chance to restore 3% of your maximum mana.

valkyrie.name: Sunslam
valkyrie.desc: Slam an enemy every 1 sec with the might of the sun, dealing AP Holy damage and stunning them for 1 seconds. Lasts 3 seconds.Only usable while Dawn is active. Usable while moving.

valkyrie.name: Vindicator
valkyrie.desc: Your Glorious Execution now ignores -10% of the target's armor while Vow of the Valkyr is active. (up to 2 ranks)

valkyrie.name: It's Always Sunny
valkyrie.desc: Activating Dawn now reduces the cooldowns of Radiance, Valkyr's Calling, and Sunslam by 10%.

valkyrie.name: Atone, Or Else
valkyrie.desc: Fervor of the Sun now stacks up to 3 additional times.

valkyrie.name: Judgement of the Valkyrie
valkyrie.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Judgement Day by -15 sec.

valkyrie.name: Leap of the Valkyrie
valkyrie.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Sun Stride by -4 sec.

valkyrie.name: Arbiter of Grace
valkyrie.desc: While Vow of Grace is active, your Glorious Execution now regenerates an additional 15% mana equal to the damage dealt.

valkyrie.name: Arbiter of Light
valkyrie.desc: While Vow of Light is active, your Gavel of Light now restores an additional 100% health equal to the damage dealt.

valkyrie.name: By The Light
valkyrie.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Valkyr's Calling by 50%.

valkyrie.name: Last Call
valkyrie.desc: Increases the duration of Valkyr's Calling by 1 sec.
